notes: Visionect's Joan-branded room-scheduling e-paper touch panel. "Joan 6" is the family name; getjoan.com/shop/joan-6/ redirects to the "Joan 6 RE" (bestseller/base variant) spec page used here. A "Joan 6 Pro" variant also exists (longer 6-month battery life, adds WPA2-Enterprise) but has the identical physical port set. Both variants have exactly one physical connector: a single USB-C port used for both charging and wired configuration (spec sheet does not state USB speed/version, so grade is omitted). The device is otherwise wireless-only: Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n (2.4/5 GHz) and Bluetooth 5 — not physical ports. No built-in Ethernet/PoE; wired LAN/PoE is only available via a separate optional wall-mount accessory (not part of the device itself), so it is not listed as a device port. Desktop/wall unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Manufacturer legal name is "Visionect d.o.o." (Slovenia); "Visionect" used per naming convention.
